title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: MCP-based agents for US Government clouds
summary: Hold: the briefing gives an outdated licence requirement for tenant-wide tool-access controls. The current Agent 365 service description lists this control as a core capability included with a Microsoft cloud subscription, not just a premium capability. The roadmap facts, blocking path and API are supported.
